title: Arkret Invite Delivery
description: Actor-private plaintext account-data typed current result value containing directed-invite credentials and untrusted authority-bundle locator hints. It is not part of Realm history.

updated_at.description: Instant of the accepted CAS write that produced this value.

delivery_entries.description: Bounded register of delivered invite credentials, oldest first. At most one entry per invite_id; a redelivery of the same invite_id replaces the previous entry. Entries whose expires_at has passed are purged on the next write; overflow beyond 200 evicts the oldest entries.

invite_id.description: Invite ID derived from the accepted ak.invite.create Event; the deduplication key of this register.

inviter_account_id.description: Complete AccountId of the inviter, copied from the accepted invite Event and verified by the delivery chain.

invite_token.description: Opaque server-issued private invite locator token used by the invitee's accept path. Clients MUST treat it as an opaque string and MUST NOT persist it anywhere outside this typed current result or equivalent holder-private state.

authority_locator_hints.description: One to eight untrusted locator cores, strictly sorted by service_id UTF-8 bytes. service_id is the semantic identity key; duplicate or conflicting representations of one service_id invalidate the entire array. The invitee must fetch and verify a nonce-bound RealmAuthorityBundle before any preview, join submission, or bootstrap request.

received_at.description: Instant the recipient Station accepted this delivery into the typed current result.

expires_at.description: Expiry of the underlying invite credential; an entry with expires_at <= now is stale and MUST NOT be used to accept the invite.
